description: Puts a lap's automatic follow-ups on hold, as its Hold follow-ups switch does: lead follow-ups, a feedback check-in and a review request all obey the one hold. No step goes out on its own; each is drafted for a person. Turning them back on is your person's, in the app. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: hold_follow_ups
title: Hold automatic follow-ups
